author: killerwhale
name: Electric Jet Engines
description: Converts the Wheesley, Whittle, and Goliath turbofans to run on ElectricCharge instead of fuel — making atmospheric flight possible on Duna, Eve, and Jool without burning a drop of propellant. Requires a power source to operate. Electric mode is a part variant unlocked through new Electric Aviation tech nodes, and each conversion (Wheesley, Whittle, Goliath, tech tree) is a campaign feature you can switch on or off per campaign. The Z-1K rechargeable battery moves into the first Electric Aviation node.
